label.description: If we can display a display name for the link, we will use this label.

custom_field_name_prefix.description: That will be added to the attribute labels if they are used for custom fields. If you specify `Acme:` as the prefix, the custom field will be named `Acme: Score`. Putting in the name of your company/product is a good idea.

details.description:
Additional details with attributes that will be added to the result. This can be percentages, scores, or any text.

We generally recommend using short attribute keys and a short custom_field_name_prefix to avoid overflowing the ATS UI.

assessment_package_id.description: The package ID of the assessment that the result link will be added to.

override_document_category.description: Allows you to override the document category for the url. (Default: MISC)

multi_post_to_all_current_applications.description: If true, the result link will be posted to all current applications for the candidate.

allOf.description: Additional fields that we will pass through to specific ATS systems.

On-Behalf-Of.description: ID of the the user that will show up as having performed the action in Greenhouse. We already pass a value by default, but you can use this to override it.

post_headers.description: Headers we will pass with `POST` requests to Greenhouse.

on_behalf_of_user_remote_id.description: The remote ID of the user that will be displayed in the UI as the one that performed the action.

workable.description: Workable specific remote fields for ATS actions.

allOf.description: Additional fields that we will pass through to specific ATS systems.

remote_fields.description: Additional fields that we will pass through to specific ATS systems.
